purpose: Foreground-only rendering vocabulary and renderer proof for the genlocked-background Amiga OCS house style.

generation_references.role: subject-neutral foreground rendering vocabulary for pre-quantisation masters

target_examples.role: human review target; never sent to img2img

generation_prompt.intent: Create a clean pre-quantisation portrait master for later reduction through the deterministic OCS renderer.
generation_prompt.composition: Keep the source viewpoint and complete silhouette, make its primary foreground subject dominant, and leave clear padding for matte extraction.
generation_prompt.rendering: Broad connected tonal shapes, deliberate edges, readable material ramps, and controlled microtexture concentrated in the foreground.
generation_prompt.lighting: Readable midtones and highlights with warm/cool separation chosen to suit the source rather than a fixed scene.
generation_prompt.palette_direction: Full controlled OCS-friendly range with dark anchors, bright midtones, clear highlights, and varied warm/cool foreground separation.
generation_prompt.avoid: Generated scenery or backgrounds, copied board arrangements, visible pixels, dithering, checker patterns, scanlines, CRT effects, text, borders, card frames, UI, props, and invented narrative elements.
